## Frequently Asked Questions{#faqs}

---

::: {.callout-note collapse="false"}

### Is there an open-bar?

Yes, there will be an open-bar for guests to enjoy throughout the cocktail hour and reception.

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="false"}

### Is there parking at the venue?

Yes, there is an on-site parking lot available for all guests. We recommend carpooling if you plan to enjoy the open bar - we want everyone getting home safely.

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="false"}

### Are kids welcome?

Absolutely - we love little ones! We just ask that you indicate ahead in your RSVP how many kids you're bringing so we can plan accordingly.

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="false"}

### What is the dress code? Is it strict?

We'd love for our guests to dress in formal or semi-formal attire. Not strict, just encouraged.

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="false"}

### Will the wedding be indoors or outdoors?

Both the ceremony and the reception will be held outdoors.

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="false"}

### What will the weather be like?

Expect Southern California weather! It should be warm during the day but might cool down in the evening, so we recommend bringing a light jacket or wrap.

:::

:::
